title: psychotria pumila var. buzica

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria pumila var. buzica include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor agent, with potential applications in treating various health conditions.
